# StackPulse v1.2.0 — Complete Technical Reference

StackPulse (`stackpulse`) is an Apache-2.0 licensed OpenTelemetry observability platform featuring W3C TraceContext DAG reconstruction (`TraceAnalyzer`), live caller-callee service topology graphs (`TopologyGraphBuilder`), Google SRE 1h/6h/24h/72h multi-window burn-rate alerts (`SLOEngine`), SSRF-hardened Slack/JSON webhook alerts (`AlertDispatcher`), automated Blameless SRE Postmortems (`IncidentCorrelator`), and RFC 6962 Nexus Aegis `G4_TRAJECTORY_HEALTH` attestations (`create_aegis_trajectory_leaf`).

## Observed Benchmark (`stackpulse benchmark --traces 500`)
- Total Traces Evaluated: `500`
- Total W3C Spans Ingested: `3,625`
- Span Ingestion Throughput: `8,486,143 spans/sec` (`0.43 ms`)
- Trace DAG Assembly Throughput: `25,710 traces/sec` (`19.45 ms`)
- Mean Critical-Path DAG Latency: `38.9 µs/trace`
